"ClipBox היא דרך נקייה ושקטה לצפות בסרטים ובסדרות באנדרואיד. הכול נמצא במקום אחד, כך שאפשר לעיין במה שפופולרי, לחפש משהו מסוים, או להמשיך בדיוק מהנקודה שבה עצרת.

ClipBox נבנית בידי צוות קטן שמשתמש בה בעצמו כל יום, והיא משתפרת בזכות מה שאנשים מספרים לנו."

ClipBox is an independent media front-end for Android. It does not host, store, upload, transmit or control any video, audio, subtitle or other media content. Everything played through the app is provided by third-party sources that are not affiliated with, endorsed by or controlled by ClipBox, and that may change or disappear at any time. ClipBox claims no ownership of third-party content and does not authorise copyright infringement. You are solely responsible for ensuring that your use of the app and of any source complies with the copyright, licensing and other laws that apply where you are. Requests to remove or disable access to content should be directed to the third-party source or rights holder concerned, as ClipBox holds no content to remove. Title and artwork metadata is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). ClipBox is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Subtitles may come from OpenSubtitles and may be machine-translated, so their accuracy and timing are not guaranteed.
